title: FHWA — Seismic Retrofitting Manual for Highway Structures: Part 1 – Bridges (isolation bearing details)
description: Detailed sections through seismic isolation bearings (lead-filled elastomeric, friction pendulum, Eradiquake) and a flowchart of the seismic retrofit process; applicable as a citable isolation-detail analogue for marine/civil structures. | Figures: Figure 8-20 — Lead-filled elastomeric isolation bearing; Figure 8-21 — Friction-pendulum isolation bearing; Figure 8-22 — Eradiquake isolation bearing; Figure 1-1 — Overview of the retrofitting process for highway bridges; Figure 1-15 — Selected retrofit measures
publisher: U.S. Department of Transportation, Federal Highway Administration (FHWA), FHWA-RD-06-032
licence: U.S. Government work; public domain with attribution. Figures not reproduced.
